headline: Growth accelerates across revenue and profits
summary_short: Robinhood's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose to $1,308M, up 22.6% q/q and 32.3% y/y, while net income climbed to $561M, up 60.3% q/q and 45.3% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue reached $1,308M, up 22.6% q/q and 32.3% y/y. Net income of $561M implies a net margin of about 42.9%, versus roughly 32.8% q/q and 39.0% y/y — a margin expansion of about 10.1ppt q/q and 3.9ppt y/y. Diluted EPS was $0.62, up 63.2% q/q and 47.6% y/y. Total cash rose to $5,362M (+7.0% q/q, +28.8% y/y), while stockholders' equity was $9,541M, down 1.5% q/q but up 18.2% y/y.
